title: Could not get it out of the packaging
text:
Could not get it out of the packaging. Edit* After a lot of pulling and really putting some strenght into that I finally got it out but it was very very difficult and took me days... I just think it could be packaged better, when I did get it out it was very easy to handle and if you put them all together they are easy to pull apart it was just the extra plastic bags that made it difficult to get out.

It was packaged so wrong and stuck together like glue with plastic bags, I struggled and struggled I tried everything, pulling it with my fingers, using water...I even thought of trying to use oil but that would probably only make it difficult for me to pull it so I didn't do that but I did pull it with all the force in the universe and could not, for the life of me get it out... I am very displeased with this purchase as I did not get to actually use my product since it literally won't come out of the terrible packaging. I am leaving only 3 stars because the product is as described and it does look like the picture, other than that, what a cheap product, terrible. Also if you have any advice on how to get it out would be appreciated... what else is there, I might change my review if I manage to get it out :(
